Subject: Vendor registration / PO requirements for Redwood Inference

Hi Rachel,

We're starting the vendor registration for Redwood so we can issue the first PO for the proof-of-concept work. To finish the profile in our supplier portal we need a few items from you:

- Official remit/billing address (legal entity name).
- Tax ID (for US payments) and VAT registration evidence if you invoice our EU entities.
- Bank wiring instructions and ACH routing (separate for USD / EUR if applicable).
- Sample invoice showing PO number placement and invoice numbering convention.
- A contact for tax/resale certificate questions.

Our AP has historically required: PO# in the invoice header, line-level product codes for services, and the supplier ID (generated after portal completion) referenced in the invoice. Payment terms are typically Net45 for new suppliers — can you confirm Redwood's standard terms and whether you accept remit to multiple bank currencies?

Also if you prefer, we can send a DocuSign for supplier forms. We'll need these documents to create your supplier ID in our system and attach them to the file.

Thanks,
Samantha Lopez

- VAT/europe: We do have an EU legal entity (Redwood Inference B.V.) with VAT ID NL123456789B01. For invoices billed to EU entities we should be paid to the EU bank (SEPA); the Sample_Invoice_EUR.pdf is formatted to show the EU VAT field and our EU invoice header.

- Payment terms: Net30 is our standard. For a new enterprise customer, Net45 is acceptable for the first PO; please mark that as a one-time exception. Future invoices should default to Net30 per contract (if/when executed).
- Bank instructions: Use the ACH details in the onboarding packet for USD; for EUR use our EU account (IBAN: NL62REDW0000001234, BIC: REDWNL2A). If they send a wire and deduct fees, please have them remit gross amounts or include a fee recovery line on the invoice.

Attachments: Vendor_Tax_Declaration.pdf (pdf), Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_filled.pdf (pdf)
